mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_embedding(ad_id,embedding,model) VALUES(#{adId},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),'catalog-event') ON CONFLICT (ad_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding,model=EXCLUDED.model

INSERT INTO ad_servable(ad_id,advertiser_id,item_id,title,landing_url,quality_score, status,review_status,optimization_type,target_cpa,audience_id,max_bid,servable, bidwords_json,creatives_json,updated_at) VALUES(#{event.adId},#{event.advertiserId},#{event.itemId},#{event.title},#{event.landingUrl},#{event.qualityScore}, #{event.status},#{event.reviewStatus},#{event.optimizationType},#{event.targetCpa},#{event.audienceId},#{maxBid},TRUE, #{bidwordsJson},#{creativesJson},now()) ON CONFLICT (ad_id) DO UPDATE SET advertiser_id=EXCLUDED.advertiser_id,item_id=EXCLUDED.item_id,title=EXCLUDED.title, landing_url=EXCLUDED.landing_url,quality_score=EXCLUDED.quality_score,status=EXCLUDED.status, review_status=EXCLUDED.review_status,optimization_type=EXCLUDED.optimization_type, target_cpa=EXCLUDED.target_cpa,audience_id=EXCLUDED.audience_id,max_bid=EXCLUDED.max_bid, servable=TRUE,bidwords_json=EXCLUDED.bidwords_json,creatives_json=EXCLUDED.creatives_json,updated_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT bidwords_json FROM ad_servable WHERE ad_id=#{adId}
SELECT ad_id,title FROM ad_servable WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT ad_id,COALESCE(optimization_type,'CPC') AS optimization_type,COALESCE(target_cpa,0) AS target_cpa FROM ad_servable WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT ad_id,item_id,advertiser_id,COALESCE(quality_score,0) AS quality_score FROM ad_servable WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT ad_id,COALESCE(max_bid,0) AS max_bid FROM ad_servable WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT ad_id,audience_id FROM ad_servable WHERE audience_id IS NOT NULL AND ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
